name: feature-coordinator
description: Local-first coordination of one feature across many git repositories on any host - GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gerrit, Gitea, self-hosted or local: a coordinator session plus one worker session per repo worktree, locked contracts, triaged reviews, visible decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Run one feature across many git repos, locally, on any host
interface.longDescription: Plan a cross-repo feature as one spec and one contract-locking plan, run one session per repository worktree on your own machine, and mix repos from GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gerrit, Gitea, self-hosted servers and local-only repos. Review feedback is triaged instead of blindly applied, and every autonomous decision stays visible.
defaultPrompt: Start a feature that spans several of our repositories.
Give me a brief on the feature I'm coordinating.
